description: For every valuation and literal-list clause list, clause-list satisfaction is equivalent to truth of the shared propositional CNF formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.listModels_formula.{u} {β : Type u}
  (w : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation β)
  (L : List (List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral β))) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.ListModels w L ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval w (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.cnfFormula L) = true
